data-attr.description: Sets one or more attribute values using a set of key-value pairs that map to the attribute name and expression.

data-attr:*.description: Sets an element’s attribute value based on an expression.

data-bind.description: Creates a new signal and enables two-way binding between it and the element.

data-bind:*.description: Creates a new signal and enables two-way binding between it and the element.

data-class.description: Adds or removes one or more classes from an element using a set of key-value pairs that map to the class name and expression.

data-class:*.description: Adds or removes a class from an element based on an expression.

data-computed.description: Creates one or more signals that are computed based on a set of key-value pairs that map to the signal name and expression.

data-computed:*.description: Creates a signal that is computed based on an expression.

data-custom-validity.description: Adds custom validity to an element using an expression.

data-effect.description: Executes an expression on page load and whenever any signals in the expression change.

data-ignore.description: Ignores an element and its descendants from being processed.

data-ignore-morph.description: Ignores an element when patching an element using the `morph` mode.

data-indicator.description: Creates a signal to track in-flight backend requests.

data-indicator:*.description: Creates a signal to track in-flight backend requests.

data-init.description: Runs an expression whenever the attribute is initialised.

data-json-signals.description: Sets the text content of an element to a reactive JSON stringified version of signals.

data-match-media:*.description: Sets a signal to whether a media query matches and keeps it in sync whenever the query changes.

data-nonce.description: Enables Content Security Policy mode using a nonempty nonce. This attribute is only allowed on the `html` element.

data-on.description: Runs an expression whenever an event is triggered on an element.

data-on:click.description: Runs an expression whenever the element is clicked.

data-on:keydown.description: Runs an expression whenever a key is pressed.

data-on-intersect.description: Runs an expression on intersection with the viewport.

data-on-interval.description: Runs an expression at a regular interval.

data-on-raf.description: Runs an expression on every `requestAnimationFrame` event.

data-on-resize.description: Runs an expression whenever an element’s dimensions change.

data-on-signal-patch.description: Runs an expression whenever one or more signals are patched.

data-on-signal-patch-filter.description: Filters which signals to watch when using the `data-on-signal-patch` attribute.

data-persist:*.description: Persists signals in local storage with a custom key.

data-preserve-attr.description: Preserves the value of an attribute when patching elements using the `morph` mode.

data-query-string.description: Syncs query string params to signal values on page load, and syncs signal values to query string params on change.

data-ref.description: Creates a signal whose value references an element.

data-ref:*.description: Creates a signal whose value references an element.

data-replace-url.description: Replaces the URL in the browser with an evaluated expression.

data-show.description: Shows or hides an element based on whether an expression evaluates to `true` or `false`.

data-signals.description: Merges one or more signals into the existing signals using a set of key-value pairs that map to the signal name and expression.

data-signals:*.description: Merges a signal into the existing signals.

data-style.description: Adds or removes one or more inline CSS styles from an element using a set of key-value pairs that map to the style name and expression.

data-style:*.description: Adds or removes an inline CSS style from an element based on an expression.

data-text.description: Sets the text content of an element to the evaluated expression.

data-view-transition.description: Sets the value of `view-transition-name` for use with the View Transition API.
